BiblicalUsage: hêydâd is the word for a shout of joy, an acclamation. I meet it 5 times across the Bible, and Isaiah is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What hêydâd tells me is that joy that cannot stay quiet is the right response to God. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
